name: job-hunt-agent
description: An open, profile-agnostic career agent for any country or occupation: onboarding into a verified truth profile, job discovery with parallel company-research agents, transparent fit scoring, Resume Lab audits and Estimated ATS Compatibility, truthful applications in the candidate's own voice, an application agent that learns ATS portals and leaves every gate and the submit to the candidate, guided fill for job-board forms, and pipeline follow-up.
